channel_and_receiver_configuration.receiver_estimate: DMRS LS or diagnostic diagonal-CFR oracle; oracle excluded from model inputs
channel_and_receiver_configuration.trial_unit: independent TDL draw; receiver views are paired descendants

configuration.snr_definition: post-channel, pre-beamforming receive-grid mean complex power divided by proper-complex AWGN variance; noise seeds are held fixed across SNR points
configuration.trial_unit: one independent standardized channel parent, reused across SNR points

interpretation: All SNR points use identical standardized channel truth, parent IDs, transmit seeds, and noise seeds.
Different SNRs change the noise variance; they are paired receiver views, not independent channel evidence.
Parent-cluster intervals are conditional on the sampled TDL-D family and do not support scene/site generalization.
The finite sinc-discretized time-domain TDL and ideal-CFR control are diagnostics, not physical truth.
This is not a deployment BLER curve, standards certification, G5 pass, or G3 receiver qualification.

diagonal_cfr_oracle.sampling_unit: independent group; all paired trials within each sampled group
diagonal_cfr_oracle.warning: Cluster bootstrap inference is conditional on the supplied groups; it does not replace independent-site or external-data validation.
